Preserve Statement.description: Keyword use: 'preserve <payload> as <label> into <ledger>' seals operational intent into append-only storage.

Verify Statement.description: Keyword use: 'verify <asset> with <proof>' validates cryptographic SHA-256 Merkle proofs.

English Assignment (set).description: Keyword use: 'set <variable> to <value>' declares or updates variable state in natural English.

English Assignment (let).description: Keyword use: 'let <variable> be <value>' introduces local variable bindings.

English Constant (remember).description: Keyword use: 'remember <NAME> as <value>' assigns an immutable constant binding.

English Increment.description: Keyword use: 'increase <var> by <delta>' increments numerical state by the given amount.

English Decrement.description: Keyword use: 'decrease <var> by <delta>' decrements numerical state by the given amount.

Whenever Conditional.description: Keyword use: 'whenever <cond>: ... otherwise if ...: ... otherwise:' natural conditional branch.

Unless Conditional.description: Keyword use: 'unless <condition>:' executes when condition evaluates to false.

Until Loop.description: Keyword use: 'until <condition>:' repeats while condition remains false.

Repeat Loop.description: Keyword use: 'repeat <N> times:' concise, high-performance counting loop.

For Each Loop.description: Keyword use: 'for each <item> in <collection>:' natural iteration over iterables.

Forever Loop.description: Keyword use: 'forever:' infinite execution loop with sub-millisecond dispatch.

Give Back Statement.description: Keyword use: 'give back <expression>' returns a value from a function or subroutine.

Try Recover Always.description: Keyword use: 'try: ... recover as err: ... always:' natural error trapping and cleanup.

Ensure Assertion.description: Keyword use: 'ensure <cond> otherwise <msg>' asserts an invariant with custom error message.

Say Statement.description: Keyword use: 'say <expr>' prints expressions to standard output.

Show Statement.description: Keyword use: 'show <expr>' prints formatted values directly to output.

Pipeline Transformation.description: Keyword use: '<val> |> <fn>' functional pipeline forwarding with placeholder support.
